name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=chapter, descriptor=08_end). The '08' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are domain IDs that must be kept), not an address remnant. Function body is exactly the chapter-8 end handler dispatched from the chapter-end pointer table @ 0x51de9 slot 7 (entry @ 0x51e05 = 0x000234bb), so the name accurately reflects purpose and logic.
purpose: Chapter 8 end handler: stage the post-battle recruit scene, play the closing cutscene, fade to black, recruit char #5 (Lona), persist the party, and advance the current-chapter id.
logic_summary: Copies two 10-byte scene position tables (X @ 0x520ff, Y @ 0x52109) onto the stack, then calls fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro(x_ptr, y_ptr, 2, 0, 9, 0x1c, 0xe, 0x10, 0, 8, 0xe) -- facing arg 2 (<4) means every placed char (chars 0..9) faces direction 2 with no facing table, extra char 0x1c placed at (0xe,0x10) facing 0, camera origin (8,0xe). Plays the cutscene: dialog page 3; battle_anim_phase=0; cutscene event 0x21; dialog page 4; cutscene_event_state=1; battle_anim_phase=0; cutscene event 0x22; cutscene_event_state=0. Fades to black via fd2_set_vga_palette_range(0,0xff,0x40) + memset(0xa0000,0,64000). Recruits char #5 via fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(5), saves runtime chars to template, then INCs current_chapter_id. In the binary this ends with PUSH 5; JMP 0x2327d (tail-jump into fd2_chapter_05_end's tail); the source emits the recruit+save+INC inline (Layer 2 functional equivalence).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: stages chars/camera, plays cutscene, fades screen, recruits char #5, persists party state, advances current_chapter_id.

notes: Verified against decompile + full disassembly (PUSH 0x50 __CHK prologue; 2x MOVSD+MOVSW copies from 0x520ff and 0x52109; setup_chars args confirmed in reverse push order; palette/memset fade; PUSH 5; JMP 0x2327d tail into fd2_chapter_05_end). Callee fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro decompiled to confirm param semantics (param_3<4 => fixed facing; arg_stack_c => extra char; arg_stack_1c/20 => camera origin) -- source comment's interpretation is exact. Dispatch entry @ 0x51e05 holds 0x000234bb (chapter-end pointer table). Scene-table globals exist as byte[10] @ 0x520ff/0x52109 with names byte-identical to source. Recruit char #5 = 洛娜 (聖騎士/龍騎士) per fd2-knowledge, matching plate's 騎士洛娜. No source edit and no plate edit needed; only the shard changes. No logic/equivalence issues found.
